Name: Lemonade Machine (CFR)
Author: tnt2018
Description:
This is a mod which uses CustomFarmingRedux and PyTk, to add a Lemonade Machine, which can turn the 6 different fruit tree fruits into Lemonade, in 2 days, doubling the original standard fruit sell price.

Installation:
o Download and extract PyTk (Platonymous Toolkit) into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods
[/code]o Download and extract CFR (CustomFarmingRedux) into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods
[/code]o Download and extract Lemonade Machine (CFR) into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods
[/code]o Load Stardew Valley using SMAPI

If downloaded and installed correctly, in your crafting menu, there should be a Lemonade Machine.


[url=https://github.com/tnt-2018/StardewMods]Source Code[/url]
